latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Inventory & Supply Chain Manager, providing end-to-end control for stock, suppliers, and forecasting.

- Supports ABC-XYZ classification for precise SKU segmentation.
- Includes demand forecasting methods and checklist for forecast accuracy.
- Guides on reorder point, safety stock, and EOQ calculations.
- Supplier management with scorecard, dual sourcing, and detailed records.
- Warehouse zoning, location coding, and cycle counting schedules provided.
